task.name: capcom_fix_stress_bad
task.objective: Fix the intentionally broken stress_bad module so Capcom and an Ollama model can repair it on the fly.

constraints.rule: php -l must pass on every .inc and .module file when done.
The autocomplete callback must return a JSON object of matches, not a PHP array and not an undefined function.
Minimal diff. Do not rewrite the module.

task.instructions: 1. Run php -l on stress_bad.broken.inc. Fix the parse error. 2. Run php -l on stress_bad.autocomplete.inc. Replace the missing helper with a real function that returns JSON. 3. Re-lint both files. Stop when both pass.
